disposition.reviewer: Codex evidence review (not maintainer publication approval)
disposition.rationale: The frozen DLL is byte-identical to scipy-openblas64 0.3.34.106.0 and the locked NumPy wheel. The supplier license expressly identifies OpenBLAS/LAPACK plus statically incorporated GCC runtime with Exception 3.1. The version-tagged supplier Windows recipe uses ordinary GCC/gfortran compilation into this independent OpenBLAS/GCC-runtime Target Code combination. Applying Exception section 1 to that supplier-described combination is the documented interpretation: it may be conveyed under the BSD terms of the independent modules; no separate standalone libgfortran runtime DLL is shipped. Complete BSD, GPLv3 and exception texts are retained. No extra GCC source delivery is required for this combination under that exception; this does not waive source duties for independent runtime-library distributions or modified builds.
